_note: The app-harvest rotation: which verticals the weekly recon sweep scans next. Derived from software-factory-core/context/vertical_coverage.md (its own ordering rule: any never-scanned vertical first, then least-recently-scanned), two verticals per sweep. `sweeps_per_week` and `slot_cron` mirror the Weekly Market Recon job. Update this file when the ledger changes — the daily sweep writes the ledger, a human or Simon rewrites this list.
